findings.message: The new rc=130 (interrupted) and rc=10 (out_of_turns) exit branches write the v2 result and a stage summary but never call emit_event "monitor.alert", unlike every other failure path in this function (generic router failure, unparseable response, verdict!=pass) — the two failure modes this ADR-063 migration exists to surface are the ones excluded from monitor's own declared alerting event.

trap '_monitor_interrupt_handler' TERM INT is unconditionally cleared with `trap - TERM INT` after route_to_model returns, resetting to the OS default handler rather than restoring whatever trap (if any) the caller had installed before monitor_stage_run ran, so any outer signal handling in scope for the remainder of this stage's process lifetime is silently dropped.
